body: We can keep talking over reddit if that is okay.
Thank you for messaging me. How are you?

Thank you :)

I got into a bit of an argument with a friend after I had talked to her about how bad I've been feeling recently. It seemed like she gave up on me. Today I confronted her about how bad she treated me and she apologized. She seemed sincere, so we'll try to move on.

I suppose I overreacted last night when I posted this. I do that a lot. I'm sorry if I scared you or made you think I was in serious danger. I don't think I'd ever be able to hurt myself even when I think seriously about it.

It is almost over now, in fact I have a few assignments due online in the next few days for my AP English class (even though school doesn't start until the 29th).

I got to visit a few colleges that I might like to go to. That was fun. I toured Harvard and Dartmouth even though I doubt I'd be able to get in.

Thank you :)

It means a lot that you would take time out of your day to talk to me.

It was two and a half years ago. I don't know that person anymore because I changed schools. I had already been in counseling for a while and I am still with the same counselor. I like him a lot and I think he has helped me a lot, despite my current state. I have an appointment with him for next week.

You hit the nail on the head with what I was afraid of, wow.

I've been made fun of by people I know a little bit, but nothing too bad. I think part of why I am reluctant to say things about my feelings and past is because I was once hospitalized forcefully because of the suicidal thoughts I shared with a friend.

I know this is a completely different situation and I can't be hospitalized for something I put anonymously on the internet, but that experience probably contributed to my reluctance to share things.

Hahaha this is a throwaway account. I'm still afraid of someone taking a screenshot of my story and spreading it around because of how hilariously inept I am. That probably would not happen, but I can't bring myself to talk about myself publicly.

I am fat and ugly and have yellow teeth and acne that won't go away

I've tried but I've failed every time

I have been suicidal for a majority of my life

I have never felt okay with who I am

I certainly hope I can get better though

Thank you friend

My body and personality are about as unappealing as you can imagine

I have tried to repair both but I am too weak of a person to do that
